title: Psychosocial burden and care during acute care in pediatric oncology and hematology (BelVerA) - a longitudinal analysis
summary: Within the scope of the research project, a screening questionnaire for pediatric oncology and hematology will be developed and tested to assess the psychosocial burden of affected families. Furthermore, the psychosocial burden will be assessed 3 times during the course of acute treatment. For this purpose, affected parents of children aged 0 to 17 years as well as diseased children and adolescents aged 7 to 17 years will fill out questionnaires on their physical and mental well-being. In addition, the association between psychosocial stress, implemented psychosocial care, and satisfaction with care will be investigated. This will provide insights into which families are at risk for increased psychosocial distress and which psychosocial care measures should be implemented during the course of acute treatment.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with an oncological, hematological or stem cell transplant treated disease between the ages of 0 and 17 years and one parent or primary caregiver are included in the study. The patients have to be in the phase of acute treatment.
Exclusion criteria:
cognitive impairment, palliative diagnose, insufficient knowledge of German
